description: This file defines the Pager class, a render element for pagination in Drupal, including properties, methods for rendering and cache context management, and annotations for theme integration.

classes.name: Pager
classes.description: A render element class for pagination controls, extending RenderElementBase, with methods for retrieving info and pre-render cache context setup.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns default properties and configuration for the pager render element.

methods.name: preRenderPager
methods.description: Adds cache context for URL query arguments to optimize caching of the pager element.
